profile.visual_desc: Human in layered dark blue robes with a red central tabard. Wears a blue cylindrical cap and matching face veil. Features prominent pointed ears.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Shadowed eyes under a blue cap. A blue veil covers the lower face. Narrow, intense gaze with a red scar across the nose.
profile.weapon_desc: Large wooden staff with a bulbous, rounded head held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Standing upright facing ↘. Staff is held vertically in the right hand, left hand at the side.
profile.step2_windup: Maintains upright stance while shifting weight slightly to prepare a magical incantation.
profile.step3_impact: Crouches forward, holding the staff horizontally across the chest with both hands. A radiant golden energy glow appears at the staff's head.
profile.step4_finish: Stays in the hunched channeling pose as the light dissipates, then returns to an upright standing position.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The energy effect manifests as a static, radiating glow centered on the horizontal staff head in the lower frame set.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence follows the reference wind-up and attack phases. VFX placement and hand positioning are generally consistent.
